content.short: What we do: Gamify college sports collectibles. Pay the student athlete's royalties.
content.description: MVPz is reinventing fantasy sports by integrating blockchain technology. Athletes are featured on NFT trading cards, these card are then traded by users to who look to build out their fantasy team. Users shall enter these teams into a fantasy sports competition, wherein points are rewarded depending on the real world performance of the featured athletes. The principles of gamification is what drives the user demand for cards. The transaction fees that are generated from the economic activity is then used to compensate the featured athletes.
